_source_of_truth: The only place the ax / Agent Substrate / GKE pins live: OpenTofu stacks read this file with jsondecode(file("${path.module}/../../exe/versions.json")), mise mirrors the CLI pin, and scripts/check_exe_pins.py (tests/unit/test_exe_pins.py) keeps them in step.

ax._go_mod_substrate_note: Copied verbatim from the pinned ax release's go.mod (github.com/agent-substrate/substrate). `just exe-cluster-src` re-reads the fetched go.mod and fails if it differs (scripts/check_exe_pins.py ax-gomod).

substrate._certificates_api_note: The certificates.k8s.io version this Substrate speaks for ClusterTrustBundles and PodCertificateRequests. v1beta1 is served only because tofu/exe-platform/gke.tf enables the two beta APIs, and Kubernetes 1.40 stops serving them. scripts/check_exe_pins.py fails from 60 days before the upgrade exclusion that holds the cluster on 1.37 ends (tofu/exe-platform/locals.tf), until the pin is a Substrate that speaks v1 and this says so.
substrate._ax_gomod_note: Until 2026-09-27 this pinned the v0.1.0 tag (fa6d949) on the bet that it was compatible with ax v0.3.1, whose go.mod requires the main-branch commit 672533541dbf; spike S1/S2 proved that wrong the same day (v0.1.0 routes to actors by Host DNS name, ax v0.3.1 by the ate-target-actor header, so no task ever turned Ready and `ax ssh` was refused). The operator chose to repin to exactly ax's requirement (manager-loop inbox M13); the pins gate accepts that pseudo-version only because it equals ax.go_mod_substrate and the SHA matches its suffix. The v0.2.0 tag was rejected: its ateapi.proto drops fields ax v0.3.1 sends (snapshots_config, readyz, golden_snapshot).
substrate._version_label_note: version_label_value is the VERSION argument handed to ate-setup and is stamped on every node under version_label_key, so it must stay both equal to version and a valid Kubernetes label value.
